Here’s a quick rundown of some notable players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey over the years—both past legends and recent stars:

| Era | Notable Players (selected) |
|-----|---------------------------|
| **Early Years / Original Clippers (1970s‑80s)** | *Alvin Robertson*, *Kenny Smith*, *Moses Malone* (brief stint), *Bill Walton* (short tenure) |
| **1990s – “Clippers of the 90s”** | *Danny Manning*, *Gary Payton*, *Michael Olowokandi* (first overall pick 1998), *Julius Erving* (short stint), *Chris Webber* (trade to Phoenix) |
| **2000s – “L.A. Clippers” era** | *Pau Gasol* (first stint 2005‑2010), *Chris Kaman*, *Derrick Rose* (drafted 2008), *DeAndre Jordan*, *Jamal Crawford*, *Chris Paul* (trade to Houston 2011) |
| **2010s – “Lakers vs. Clippers” rivalry** | *Paul George* (2013‑2019), *Kawhi Leonard* (2011‑2012), *Reggie Jackson*, *Jabari Parker*, *Bojan Bogdanović*, *Jae Crowder*, *Julius Randle* (joined 2017) |
| **Recent Years (2020‑present)** | *Russell Westbrook* (2020‑2021), *Anthony Davis* (2021‑2022), *Kawhi Leonard* (2021‑2022), *Paul George* (2022‑present), *Julius Randle* (2022‑present), *Jalen Green*, *Cameron Johnson*, *Jabari Smith Jr.* |

> **Quick note:** This isn’t an exhaustive list—many other great players have had stints with the Clippers, but the table highlights those who made a significant impact or were part of key moments in franchise history.

If you’re looking for a specific player’s tenure, stats, or a deeper dive into a particular era, just let me know!
